_meta.title: OCMP offline fail-closed vectors
_meta.note: Word-of-agreement class set for OCMP R2-R7 (all 11 §3 reason codes). These cases are NOT part of CLC-A/B authorization semantics (OCMP §8); they are fail-closed reference inputs for offline evaluation. Every entry is checked against the OCMP rules (NAM §3): missing/bad input -> deny, never raise.

vectors.scenario: Principal/agent chain does not chain to a configured trust anchor
vectors.derivation: input marked MUST in OCMP §2 is unreadable -> deny (R2)

vectors.scenario: No revocation/status snapshot available at eval time
vectors.derivation: a stale/missing snapshot MUST NOT be treated as 'no revocations' (R3)

vectors.scenario: Trusted local time t > valid_until (snapshot out of freshness window)
vectors.derivation: t > valid_until -> deny; expiry is not an availability fallback (R3)

vectors.scenario: Snapshot version lower than the last accepted one
vectors.derivation: version MUST be monotonic; a lower version MUST be rejected (R3)

vectors.scenario: Trusted local time t < as_of (not-yet-valid snapshot)
vectors.derivation: t < as_of -> deny (OCMP §8 'not-yet-valid'); same code as expired (R3)

vectors.scenario: Grant within its lifetime but listed in the snapshot as revoked
Operation reuses an already-consumed counter value / nonce
vectors.derivation: each accepted operation consumes exactly one counter value; reuse MUST be denied (R5)

vectors.scenario: Counter goes backwards, or the replay state is unwritable/corrupt
vectors.derivation: a backwards counter MUST be denied (R5)

vectors.scenario: Scheme-declared required local fact (e.g. cell occupancy) unreadable
vectors.derivation: facts MUST NOT be invented, defaulted, or cached past scheme freshness (R6)

vectors.scenario: Wall-clock offset from last trusted sync exceeds scheme tolerance
vectors.derivation: untrusted time source MUST deny rather than guess (R7)

vectors.scenario: Scheme-declared local policy (e.g. cell gate) absent at eval time
vectors.derivation: required local policy is a MUST input; unreadable -> deny (R2)

vectors.scenario: No grant in the manifest covers the request (or the grant set is absent/empty)
vectors.derivation: OCMP §3 R2 first row: no grant covers the request -> deny with the CLC-v1 §9.1 layer 10 code
